operators.name: conv_transpose1d

parameters.name: input
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided as produced by prior op (stride [C_in*L_in, L_in, 1] for input from data)

parameters.name: weight
parameters.layout: contiguous as from module parameter (stride [C_out*K, K, 1])

returns.shape: [B, C_out, L_out] where L_out = (L_in-1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding

semantics: Performs 1D transposed convolution (cuDNN) matching F.conv_transpose1d with explicit bias, stride, padding, output_padding.
Equivalently computes cross-correlation of input with gradient of Conv1d using weight layout [C_in, C_out, K].
Bias is added per output channel after convolution.
Preserves input dtype float32 and output device CUDA.
No activation; only conv transpose and bias.

operators.name: softmax

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: [B, C, L] any shape with dim axis valid
parameters.layout: supports arbitrary strides; kernel must handle or explicitly contiguousify

semantics: Computes softmax along specified dim using numerically stable algorithm (subtract max, exp, divide by sum).
For dim=1 (channel dimension), applies softmax independently per batch and spatial position across channels.
Output values sum to 1 along dim.

reference_steps.source: x = F.conv_transpose1d(x, self.conv_transpose1d.weight, self.conv_transpose1d.bias, stride=self.conv_transpose1d.stride, padding=self.conv_transpose1d.padding, output_padding=self.conv_transpose1d.output_padding)
semantics: Calls custom op cuda_extension.conv_transpose1d with input x (shape [128,3,8192]), weight [3,16,3], bias [16], stride 2, padding 1, output_padding 1.
Calls custom op cuda_extension.softmax on conv output with dim=1.
Output shape [128,16,16384], values softmaxed across channel dimension.
